en.title: Royal Family's Stroll
en.overview: The 'Royal Family's Stroll', a traditional cultural event you can experience before departure at Incheon International Airport, recreates Joseon Dynasty royal court life. At Terminal 1, the king and queen are reenacted strolling through the palace. At Terminal 2, a royal procession of the king and military officers is reenacted at the late Joseon martial arts exhibition hall. After the event, visitors can take commemorative photos with performers wearing royal court costumes and regalia for a unique experience. Watching Joseon-era life directly before your eyes
en.pull_quote: Incheon Yeongjong-gu Seasonal Recommended Festival · Incheon International Airport (2026.01.05 ~ 2026.12.31)
paragraphs: The 'Royal Family's Stroll', a traditional cultural event you can experience before departure at Incheon International Airport, recreates Joseon Dynasty royal court life. At Terminal 1, the king and queen are reenacted strolling through the palace. At Terminal 2, a royal procession of the king and military officers is reenacted at the late Joseon martial arts exhibition hall.

After the event, visitors can take commemorative photos with performers wearing royal court costumes and regalia for a unique experience. Watching Joseon-era life directly before your eyes offers special entertainment and provides sights for airport visitors. It is also a great event to watch with family.

ja.title: 王家の散歩
ja.addr: 仁川広域市永宗区空港路 272 (雲西洞)
ja.overview: 仁川国際空港で出国前に出会える伝統文化行事「王家の散歩」は、朝鮮時代の宮中生活を再現するイベントです。第1旅客ターミナルでは、王と王妃が宮殿を散歩する姿が再現されます。第2旅客ターミナルでは、朝鮮後期の武科（武官の試験）展示場に王の行幸と武官の行列が再現されます。イベント終了後、宮中服飾や儀仗物を着用した出演者と一緒に記念写真を撮ることができ、一風変わった経験ができます。朝鮮時代の生活を目の前で
ja.pull_quote: 仁川永宗区 季節のおすすめ祭り・仁川国際空港 (2026.01.05 ~ 2026.12.31)
paragraphs: 仁川国際空港で出国前に出会える伝統文化行事「王家の散歩」は、朝鮮時代の宮中生活を再現するイベントです。第1旅客ターミナルでは、王と王妃が宮殿を散歩する姿が再現されます。第2旅客ターミナルでは、朝鮮後期の武科（武官の試験）展示場に王の行幸と武官の行列が再現されます。
イベント終了後、宮中服飾や儀仗物を着用した出演者と一緒に記念写真を撮ることができ、一風変わった経験ができます。朝鮮時代の生活を目の前で直接観覧することができ、特別な楽しさをプレゼントし、空港で行われる行事として空港を訪れる訪問客に見どころを提供します。ご家族と一緒に観覧するのにもぴったりの行事です。

zh.overview: 「王室出巡」是可以在仁川國際空港（機場）出境前體驗的傳統文化活動，重現了朝鮮時代的宮中生活。在第一航廈會重現國王與王妃在宮闕內散步的景象；在第二航廈則會在朝鮮後期的武科展示場重現國王出巡與武官的儀仗隊伍。活動結束後，可以與身穿宮中服飾及儀仗道具的演出人員合影留念，帶來別具一格的體驗。親眼欣賞朝鮮時代的生活

en.title: Han River History Exploration
en.overview: The 'Han River History Exploration' program provides attractive tourist commentaries and education to appreciate and share Han River landscapes and historical/cultural assets, allowing citizens and tourists to experience and enjoy the riverside. In addition, it aims to revitalize Han River history and culture enjoyed in daily life by developing various contents that allow citizens to actively participate and experience firsthand, such as experiential activities.

paragraphs: The 'Han River History Exploration' program provides attractive tourist commentaries and education to appreciate and share Han River landscapes and historical/cultural assets, allowing citizens and tourists to experience and enjoy the riverside. Explorers walk along designated courses covering the Han River basin and nearby cultural heritage while listening to the commentary of a Han River docent. The Han River History Exploration operates on a total of 16 courses, where visitors can walk and explore the history of the Han River related to each course.

en.title: 2026 5th Jeju Biennale: Iyahong Modakchigok Iyahong : The Art of Transformation
en.overview: Civilization that blossomed on Jeju, a volcanic island of the Eurasian Plate, flowed not only from the sea but also arrived from northern land civilizations. Various elements scattered, gathered into Jeju, mixed, and transformed, shaping the ecology, geography, and lifestyle known as today's Jeju. Entering its 10th year, the 5th Jeju Biennale focuses on Jeju's dynamic process of scattering ('heok-gi-da'), gathering ('mo-dak-chi-da'), and transforming ('iyahong') upon meeting northern civilizations.
en.pull_quote: Jeju-si, Jeju Seasonal Recommended Festival · Jeju Museum of Art (2026.08.25 ~ 2026.11.15)
paragraphs: Civilization that blossomed on Jeju, a volcanic island of the Eurasian Plate, flowed not only from the sea but also arrived from northern land civilizations. Various elements scattered, gathered into Jeju, mixed, and transformed, shaping the ecology, geography, and lifestyle known as today's Jeju.

Entering its 10th year, the 5th Jeju Biennale focuses on Jeju's dynamic process of scattering ('heok-gi-da'), gathering ('mo-dak-chi-da'), and transforming ('iyahong') upon meeting northern civilizations. To this end, the biennale adopts 'Iyahong', the refrain of the 'Iyahong Taryeong' folk song that flowed from the mainland and became another indigenous folk song of Jeju, as its theme and core concept. Through Jeju, where principles of climate and diet are imbued, the Jeju Biennale aims to present the survival methods and aesthetics woven together by objects, nature, human life, and divinity.

今年で10年目を迎える第5回済州ビエンナーレは、北方文明と出会い、散らばり（ホックダ）、集まり（モダクチダ）、変容する（イヤホン）済州のダイナミックなプロセスに注目します。このため、ビエンナーレでは本土から流れ込み済州のもう一つの固有の民謡となった「イヤホンタリング」ののリフレイン「イヤホン（Iyahong）」をテーマおよびコアコンセプトに据えています。気候と摂生の原理が宿る済州を通じて、済州ビエンナーレは事物と自然、人間の生活と神性が共に紡ぎ出してきた生存の方式とその美学を提示しようとしています。

en.title: 20th Century Photography Masters Exhibition - Light, Stopping Time
en.overview: In an era where hundreds of millions of images are easily born on liquid crystal screens and vanish lightly with a single tap of a finger. Amidst the flood of digital technology and artificial intelligence, anyone can easily capture and duplicate moments. Within the maze of light pixels, the heavy resonance and lingering imagery conveyed by analog photography are gradually fading. Amidst the repetition of easy production and consumption, we are losing the 'authenticity of gazing' at subjects deeply for a long time.
en.pull_quote: Seoul Jung-gu Recommended Seasonal Festival · Art Chosun Space (2026.11.20 ~ 2027.03.28)
paragraphs: In an era where hundreds of millions of images are easily born on liquid crystal screens and vanish lightly with a single tap of a finger. Amidst the flood of digital technology and artificial intelligence, anyone can easily capture and duplicate moments. Within the maze of light pixels, the heavy resonance and lingering imagery conveyed by analog photography are gradually fading. Amidst the repetition of easy production and consumption, we are losing the 'authenticity of gazing' at subjects deeply for a long time.

Since its inception, photography has been a physical exploration mediated by light and an art of time that captures and leaves behind a single cross-section of flowing time. The masterpieces born from the fingertips of 20th-century masters were not mere reproductions of phenomena through cold machines. They were the artists' unique philosophies that stared squarely at and interpreted the world. As a concept contrasting with digital images, analog-printed photographic works are called 'physical prints'. These are photographs completed as silver salt (photosensitive components combining silver and halogen elements) and platinum textures permeate the printing paper under the red light of a darkroom.

ja.title: 20世紀の写真巨匠展 - 光、時間を止める
ja.addr: ソウル特別市中区世宗大路21ギル30 (太平路1街)
ja.overview: 一日に何億枚もの画像が液晶画面の上で簡単に生まれ、指一本で軽く消滅する時代。デジタル技術と人工知能の氾濫の中で、誰もが簡単に瞬間を捉えて複製できるようになった。軽いピクセルの迷宮の中で、アナログ写真が伝える重厚な響きと残像は徐々に薄れている。簡単な生産と繰り返しが繰り返される中、私たちは対象を長く深く凝視する「見つめることの真正性」を失いつつある。
ja.pull_quote: ソウル中区 季節のおすすめ祭り · アート朝鮮スペース (2026.11.20 ~ 2027.03.28)
paragraphs: 一日に何億枚もの画像が液晶画面の上で簡単に生まれ、指一本で軽く消滅する時代。デジタル技術と人工知能の氾濫の中で、誰もが簡単に瞬間を捉えて複製できるようになった。軽いピクセルの迷宮の中で、アナログ写真が伝える重厚な響きと残像は徐々に薄れている。簡単な生産と繰り返しが繰り返される中、私たちは対象を長く深く凝視する「見つめることの真正性」を失いつつある。

写真は誕生の瞬間から光を媒体とした物理的探求であり、流れる時間の一断面を捉えて残す時間の芸術であった。20世紀の巨匠の指先から生まれた名作たちは、冷たい機械を通じた単なる現象の複製ではなかった。世の中を正面から凝視し、解釈した作家固有の哲学であった。デジタル画像と対比される概念として、アナログ方式で焼き付け・出力した写真作品を「フィジカルプリント(physical print)」と呼ぶ。暗室の赤い灯りの下で銀塩（銀とハロゲン元素が結びついた感光成分）の粒子と白金のキメが印画紙に染み込みながら完成した写真たちである。

zh.title: 20世紀攝影巨匠展 - 光，凝結時間
zh.addr: 首爾特別市中區世宗大路21街30（太平路1街）
zh.overview: 在這個每天都有數億張影像在螢幕上輕鬆誕生、又隨著手指輕輕一揮而消逝的時代。在數位技術與人工智慧氾濫的洪流中，每個人都能輕易捕捉並複製瞬間。在輕盈的像素迷宮中，類比攝影所傳遞的厚重迴響與餘韻正逐漸淡去。在輕易的生產與消費不斷重複的同時，我們正逐漸失去對主體進行長久、深邃凝視的「凝視的真實性」。
zh.pull_quote: 首爾中區季節推薦慶典 · Art Chosun Space（2026.11.20 ~ 2027.03.28）
paragraphs: 在這個每天都有數億張影像在螢幕上輕鬆誕生、又隨著手指輕輕一揮而消逝的時代。在數位技術與人工智慧氾濫的洪流中，每個人都能輕易捕捉並複製瞬間。在輕盈的像素迷宮中，類比攝影所傳遞的厚重迴響與餘韻正逐漸淡去。在輕易的生產與消費不斷重複的同時，我們正逐漸失去對主體進行長久、深邃凝視的「凝視的真實性」。

攝影自誕生之日起，便是以光為媒介的物理探索，是捕捉並留下流逝時間其中一個切面的時間藝術。誕生於20世紀巨匠指尖的名作，絕非透過冰冷機器對現象的單純複製，而是作者直視世界並進行詮釋的獨特哲學。作為與數位影像相對應的概念，以類比方式沖洗、輸出的攝影作品被稱為「實體照片（physical print）」。這些照片是在暗室的紅燈下，由銀鹽（銀與鹵素元素結合的感光成分）粒子與鉑金的紋理滲入相紙中完美完成的結晶。

en.title: 2026 Shwi-eom-shwi-eom Morning
en.overview: 'Shwi-eom-shwi-eom Morning' is a weekend morning event where anyone can enjoy exercise at their own pace. It is a Seoul-style morning workout program where participants can join in their preferred way tailored to their physical condition, including walking, running, cycling, as well as bringing strollers and dogs. It is a time to meet Seoul's mornings while enjoying exercise without the burden of records and rankings. It operates a total of 6 times around Gwangjin Bridge, Jamsil Bridge, and Seogang Bridge from October 18 to November 29, 2026.
en.pull_quote: Gangdong-gu, Seoul Seasonal Recommended Festival · Gwangjin Bridge / Jamsil Bridge (2026.10.18 ~ 2026.11.22)
paragraphs: 'Shwi-eom-shwi-eom Morning' is a weekend morning event where anyone can enjoy exercise at their own pace. It is a Seoul-style morning workout program where participants can join in their preferred way tailored to their physical condition, including walking, running, cycling, as well as bringing strollers and dogs. It is a time to meet Seoul's mornings while enjoying exercise without the burden of records and rankings. It operates a total of 6 times around Gwangjin Bridge, Jamsil Bridge, and Seogang Bridge from October 18 to November 29, 2026. Set against the backdrop of Seoul's grand bridges and Han River parks, participants can walk and run along the scenery of the downtown and the Han River, feeling the new charm of familiar spaces.

On-site, visitors can also enjoy GX programs with professional instructors and the 'Visiting Seoul Fitness Station' to check their physical fitness level. Whether alone or with family and friends, anyone from fitness beginners to regular exercisers can participate comfortably. Registration is done on-site on the day of the event without prior application. Locations, courses, and programs by session can be checked on the official website.

ja.title: 2026スウィオムスウィオム・モーニング

ja.overview: 誰もが自分のペースで楽しむ週末の朝、「スウィオムスウィオム・モーニング」が開催されます。ウォーキング、ランニング、サイクリングはもちろん、ベビーカーやペット同伴まで、自分の体力に合わせて自由に参加できるソウル型の朝の運動プログラムです。記録や順位へのプレッシャーから解放され、運動を楽しみながらソウルの朝に出会う時間です。2026年10月18日から11月29日まで、広津橋（クァンジンギョ）・蚕室大橋（チャムシルデギョ）・西江大橋（ソガンデギョ）周辺にて計6回運営されます。

en.title: 2026 Namsan Night Trekking "Twinkling Namsan Night Road"
en.overview: A non-competitive night trekking event where participants can enjoy Namsan's forests and night views, a representative night attraction in Seoul. Participants depart from Namsangol Hanok Village, pass through the Namsan Connecting Pedestrian Path and Namsan Park Road, and travel about 3km to Namsan Tower. The small lights of participants wearing glowing wristbands and grip-toks trail along the night road, creating a scenery reminiscent of moving fireflies. About 700 people per session are divided into 7 groups of 100 for warm-ups and safety education.

paragraphs: Hosted by Busan Metropolitan City, the 6th Busan General Folk Arts Festival is a traditional cultural celebration introducing Busan's intangible heritage and traditional folk culture through performances and hands-on experiences. Held from October 24 to 25, 2026, at Dasom Square in Busan Citizens Park, it is designed for both Busan citizens and tourists. The main programs consist of Pungryu Madang (performance-focused), Somssi Madang (experience-focused), and Janchi Madang (participation-focused).

Pungryu Madang is a space for the opening ceremony, intangible heritage performances from Busan and other regions, transmission school performances, global performances, special performances, and citizen participation programs. Somssi Madang offers intangible heritage craft and performance experiences, traditional culture-making experiences, traditional food experiences, and cultural heritage care experiences. Janchi Madang features a traditional play zone, Busan Intangible Heritage Art Fair, Hanbok Culture Week-linked traditional and craft markets, stamp tour, wish-writing, Hanbok rental, and traditional accessory experiences. This festival is designed to let visitors experience Busan's intangible heritage and traditional culture through performances and participatory activities.

en.overview: The 'All-Citizen Energy Walking Festival' is an eco-friendly energy participation program prepared to commemorate the 2026 Daejeon World Conference on Photovoltaic Energy (WCPEC-9). Walking together through downtown Daejeon in autumn, participants can directly experience the value of energy and environment, and think about a sustainable future for all citizens. This event is a walking program that anyone can joyfully participate in without ranking competition, starting from Daejeon Expo Citizens' Square and covering the Hanbat Arboretum area.
en.pull_quote: Seo-gu Daejeon Seasonal Recommended Festival · Daejeon Expo Citizens' Square (2026.11.15 ~ 2026.11.15)
paragraphs: The 'All-Citizen Energy Walking Festival' is an eco-friendly energy participation program prepared to commemorate the 2026 Daejeon World Conference on Photovoltaic Energy (WCPEC-9). Walking together through downtown Daejeon in autumn, participants can directly experience the value of energy and environment, and think about a sustainable future for all citizens. This event is a walking program that anyone can joyfully participate in without ranking competition, starting from Daejeon Expo Citizens' Square and covering the Hanbat Arboretum area to complete mobile stamp missions.

By completing a total of 4 missions through smartphone QR verification, participants can receive completion rewards and a mobile completion certificate. Along with the walking program, various programs are operated to make learning about energy easy and fun. Held on November 15, 2026, at Daejeon Expo Citizens' Square, this event is a special day where citizens can walk, learn, and experience together while naturally encountering the importance of sustainable energy and the environment. It is a citizen-participatory energy festival where individual steps gather to create a greener tomorrow.

Bjarke Ingels, the founder of BIG, is famous for an architectural style that is unique and experimental while also considering the user's purpose and experience. Visitors can examine the past and present of architecture presented by the world-class design group BIG...
en.pull_quote: Jung-gu, Seoul Seasonal Recommended Festival · Seoul Urbanism and Architecture Exhibition Center (2026.11.07 ~ 2027.02.28)
paragraphs: Korea's first special exhibition by BIG, a world-renowned architectural design group, is being held at the Seoul Urbanism and Architecture Exhibition Center. Bjarke Ingels, the founder of BIG, is famous for an architectural style that is unique and experimental while also considering the user's purpose and experience.

Offering a glimpse into his creativity, this exhibition features exhibits and models centered around 10 building materials such as stone, soil, concrete, metal, and wood. Visitors can examine the past and present of architecture presented by the world-class design group BIG, and confirm the direction for sustainable future urban architecture. In addition to the special exhibition, citizen participation programs such as a special lecture by BIG founder Bjarke Ingels on the theme of future urban architecture will be held.

ja.title: MATERIALISM｜ビャケ・インゲルス・グループ企画展
ja.addr: ソウル特別市中区世宗大路 119 (太平路1街)
ja.overview: 韓国初となる世界的な建築設計グループ「BIG」の企画展がソウル都市建築展示館で開催される。独創的かつ実験的でありながら、使用者の目的と経験をともに考慮する建築スタイルで有名なBIGの創立者ビャケ・インゲルス。彼の創造性を垣間見ることができる今回の展示は、石、土、コンクリート、金属、木材など10種類の建築材料を中心に展示物と模型で構成される。世界的な建築設計グループBIGが提示する建築の過去と現在を眺め、持続可能な未来都市建築の方向性を確認することができる。
ja.pull_quote: ソウル中区 季節のおすすめ祭り · ソウル都市建築展示館 (2026.11.07 ~ 2027.02.28)
paragraphs: 韓国初となる世界的な建築設計グループ「BIG」の企画展がソウル都市建築展示館で開催される。独創的かつ実験的でありながら、使用者の目的と経験をともに考慮する建築スタイルで有名なBIGの創立者ビャケ・インゲルス。
彼の創造性を垣間見ることができる今回の展示は、石、土、コンクリート、金属、木材など10種類の建築材料を中心に展示物と模型で構成される。世界的な建築設計グループBIGが提示する建築の過去と現在を眺め、持続可能な未来都市建築の方向性を確認することができる。企画展のほかにも、未来都市建築をテーマにしたBIG創立者ビャケ・インゲルスの特別講演など、市民参加型プログラムが実施される予定である。

en.title: Yeongju Apple Festival
en.overview: The 2026 Yeongju Apple Festival is an autumn festival to experience with all five senses the highest quality Yeongju apples grown in Yeongju's clear nature. This year, the festival delivers the taste and charm of Yeongju apples simultaneously from the production origin and the downtown area. It will be held around the Buseok-myeon Maze Park from October 30 to November 1, and events will also take place at Seoul Cheonggye Plaza from November 13 to November 15. Yeongju apples are characterized by high sugar content and crisp texture due to the large temperature range and abundant sunlight.
en.pull_quote: Taepyeongno 1-ga, Jung-gu, Seoul Seasonal Recommended Festival · Seoul Cheonggye Plaza (2026.11.13 ~ 2026.11.15)
paragraphs: The 2026 Yeongju Apple Festival is an autumn festival to experience with all five senses the highest quality Yeongju apples grown in Yeongju's clear nature. This year, the festival delivers the taste and charm of Yeongju apples simultaneously from the production origin and the downtown area. It will be held around the Buseok-myeon Maze Park from October 30 to November 1, and events will also take place at Seoul Cheonggye Plaza from November 13 to November 15. Yeongju apples are characterized by high sugar content and crisp texture due to the large temperature range and abundant sunlight. At the festival site, various experience programs, diverse variety displays, and apple markets will be held.

Colorful tasting events and cultural performances are also prepared. Visitors can fully enjoy the autumn scenery along with Buseoksa Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Blending the freshness of direct-from-farm produce with exciting performances and events, it is a fruitful venue providing pleasant memories for all ages. It is a golden opportunity to experience the superb autumn scenery of Yeongju as well as the highest quality Yeongju apples and abundant entertainment right in the heart of downtown Seoul.

ja.title: 栄州りんご祭り
ja.addr: ソウル中区太平路1街 1
ja.overview: 2026栄州りんご祭りは、栄州の豊かな自然の中で育った最高品質の栄州りんごを五感で楽しむ秋の祭り。今年の栄州りんご祭りは、栄州りんごの味と魅力を産地と都心で同時に届ける。10月30日から11月1日まで浮石面（プソクミョン）迷路公園一帯で開催され、11月13日から15日まではソウル清渓（チョンゲ）広場でもイベントが繰り広げられる。栄州りんごは昼夜の寒暖差が大きく豊富な日差しを受けて育つため、糖度が高く食感がシャキシャキしているのが特徴。
ja.pull_quote: ソウル中区太平路1街 季節のおすすめ祭り · ソウル市清渓広場 (2026.11.13 ~ 2026.11.15)
paragraphs: 2026栄州りんご祭りは、栄州の豊かな自然の中で育った最高品質の栄州りんごを五感で楽しむ秋の祭り。今年の栄州りんご祭りは、栄州りんごの味と魅力を産地と都心で同時に届ける。10月30日から11月1日まで浮石面（プソクミョン）迷路公園一帯で開催され、11月13日から15日まではソウル清渓（チョンゲ）広場でもイベントが繰り広げられる。栄州りんごは昼夜の寒暖差が大きく豊富な日差しを受けて育つため、糖度が高く食感がシャキシャキしているのが特徴。祭りの会場では、様々な体験プログラム、多彩な品種の展示、りんごの販売市が開かれる。
多彩な試食イベントや文化公演も一緒に準備される。訪問客はユネスコ世界遺産である浮石寺（プソクサ）とともに秋の風景を満喫することができる。産地直送の新鮮さと楽しい公演やイベントが調和し、老若男女問わず楽しい思い出をプレゼントする豊かな実りの場である。栄州的優れた秋の風景はもちろん、ソウルの都心の真ん中でも最高品質の栄州りんごと豊富な見どころを五感で体験できる絶好のチャンス。

en.title: 2026 Great Korean Traditional Liquor Festival
en.overview: The 2026 Great Korean Traditional Liquor Festival is Korea's largest traditional alcohol festival designed to widely promote the value and diversity of traditional liquor and strengthen communication with domestic and foreign consumers. It will be held for 3 days from November 13 to November 15, 2026, at Exhibition Hall 1 of the aT Center in Yangjae-dong, Seoul, where visitors can meet excellent traditional liquors from all over the country in one place. en.pull_quote: Seoul Gangnam-gu Recommended Seasonal Festival · SETEC Exhibition Halls 1 & 2 (2026.11.21 ~ 2026.11.22)
paragraphs: ‘Board Game Festa’ is a board game experience exhibition co-hosted by the Seoul Business Agency and the Korea Board Game Industry Association with support from Seoul Metropolitan Government. Held as the 'Seoul Board Game Festa' since 2015, it has been hosted and organized by the Korea Board Game Industry Association under the name 'Board Game Festa' since 2022.

Designed as a festival-style board game experience event to widely promote board games as a global family play and educational culture, it offers visitors board game experiences, tournaments, and events to make known the unique joy of board games. Along with Board Game Con held with the support of the Korea Creative Content Agency, it is widely known to the public as representative content for board game experience events, and plans ongoing events aiming to hold them more than twice a year to revitalize the board game industry.

ja.title: 2026ボードゲームフェスタ(シーズン2)

paragraphs: 「ボードゲームフェスタ」は、ソウル市後援、ソウル産業振興院と(社)韓国ボードゲーム産業協会が共同主催するボードゲーム体験博覧会で、2015年から「ソウルボードゲームフェスタ」として開催され、2022年からは「ボードゲームフェスタ」という名称で(社)韓国ボードゲーム産業協会がイベントを主宰、主管するようになった。

en.title: 2026 Our Rice, Our Liquor K-Rice Festa
en.overview: The K-Rice Festa is a festival that discovers, promotes, and sells traditional Korean liquors and processed rice products to expand domestic rice consumption by the public and promote the new value of our rice. It is an event where you can meet, taste, and enjoy various traditional liquors and rice processed products from all over the country in one place, introducing excellent products to consumers to create new sales channels and consumption opportunities.
en.pull_quote: Gyeonggi Goyang-si Ilsanseo-gu Recommended Seasonal Festival · KINTEX Exhibition Center 1, Hall 2 (2026.11.27 ~ 2026.11.29)
paragraphs: The K-Rice Festa is a festival that discovers, promotes, and sells traditional Korean liquors and processed rice products to expand domestic rice consumption by the public and promote the new value of our rice. It is an event where you can meet, taste, and enjoy various traditional liquors and rice processed products from all over the country in one place, introducing excellent products to consumers to create new sales channels and consumption opportunities.

In addition to exhibitions and sales, tasting, sampling, and experiential programs to experience our rice and traditional liquor in diverse ways, along with various events, are prepared.
